follow-up time: Until labor, after ultrasound scans at 36 + 0 to 37 + 6 and 39 + 0 to 41 + 6 weeks of pregnancy
outcome: Cesarean section (CS) for non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS)
finding: The longitudinal change in cerebro-placental ratio (CPR) between 37 and 40 weeks of pregnancy is associated with the need for cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status during labor.
